excerpts.content:
I would like to propose this spec update on the _by_root ReqResp requests:
- extend the blocks served from only unfinalized to the same set as the _by_range requests

I talked about this with clients during the previous Berlin interop in June 2025 and most already supported it. https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4950
